dimensions.name: React fundamentality
dimensions.rationale: Payload é admin RSC + Local API React-first; Astro usa Islands (R19 OK mas sem RSC, componentes opt-in)

dimensions.name: Vite paridade
dimensions.rationale: Astro = Vite 7 nativo (paridade total com apps/design); Payload = Next.js Turbopack

dimensions.name: Auto-hospedagem
dimensions.rationale: Ambos MIT; Astro Studio descontinuado mas Astro DB OSS via Turso; Payload Cloud paused mas self-host total

dimensions.name: TypeScript+Zod schemas
dimensions.rationale: Astro tem Zod nativo v4 em Content Collections; Payload sem Zod, bridge ts-to-zod sobre payload-types.ts

dimensions.name: Multi-tenant Hub-and-Spoke
dimensions.rationale: Payload tem plugin oficial GA; Astro sem suporte built-in, padrão multi-build

dimensions.name: Editor WYSIWYG não-dev
dimensions.rationale: Payload tem Live Preview iframe + Layout Builder + Lexical embutido; Astro não é CMS, depende de Storyblok/Sanity

dimensions.name: Live preview
dimensions.rationale: Payload tem postMessage nativo + useLivePreview; Astro depende do CMS provider

dimensions.name: SEO institucional
dimensions.rationale: Astro entrega CWV >50% pass HTTP Archive, sitemap+i18n+image+CSP+Fonts nativos; Payload via plugin-seo + Next.js stack

dimensions.name: Performance runtime
dimensions.rationale: Astro = zero JS default, ~90% menos JS que Next; Payload = Next.js baseline + cold start serverless caveat

dimensions.name: Build performance
dimensions.rationale: Astro Vite 7 (Vite 8 + Rolldown em 7-alpha 10-30x); Payload Turbopack default + admin caching v3.81

dimensions.name: DX dev
dimensions.rationale: Astro HMR rápido + error msgs OK; Payload Local API DX excelente + Next.js familiar

dimensions.name: Validação enterprise
dimensions.rationale: Astro: Cloudflare/Google/Microsoft docs, IKEA, Trivago, eBay, The Guardian, 30k+ teams. Payload: Microsoft, Disney, Bugatti, ASICS 26k+/25 idiomas, Blue Origin, Sonos, US Air Force

dimensions.name: Maturidade ecossistema
dimensions.rationale: Astro 1.25M DL/week, 58k stars, 15 integrations oficiais; Payload 150k DL/week, 40.8k stars, 11+ plugins

dimensions.name: Roadmap & risco
dimensions.rationale: Cloudflare acq MIT preservada + roadmap público; Payload Figma acq + Cloud paused, sem roadmap formal

dimensions.name: License & custo
dimensions.rationale: Astro MIT + static $0 hosting; Payload MIT mas precisa Postgres + Node persistente

dimensions.name: Curva de aprendizado
dimensions.rationale: Astro = sintaxe .astro + Islands; Payload = fields + Next.js + Drizzle/Mongoose

dimensions.name: Integração Vercel
dimensions.rationale: Astro oficial hosting partner Vercel; Payload Next.js direto + db-vercel-postgres mas cold start

dimensions.name: Multi-language i18n
dimensions.rationale: Astro built-in routing + hreflang; Payload Localization native + ASICS produção 25 idiomas

weighted_by_critical_dimensions.comment: Critical = weight >= 9 (8 dimensions). Payload domina críticos.
